ma.onSocketOpen(function callback)

Listen for WebSocket connection opening events.

Parameter

function callback

Callback function used when a WebSocket connection opening event is detected.

Parameter

Object res
Attribute Type Description
header Object HTTP response header indicating a successful connection.

Sample Code

ma.connectSocket({
  url: 'wss://example.com',
});
ma.onSocketOpen(function (res) {
  console.log(res);
});
